description: This file contains frontend API functions for NoteMaster, handling user authentication, note management, and tag retrieval via fetch calls to a backend API.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Sets the global token for authenticated requests.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with username and password.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Logs in a user and stores the received JWT token.

methods.name: getMe
methods.description: Retrieves current user information, requires authentication.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes for the current user, with optional search and tag filters.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by ID.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with title, content, and tags.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Retrieves all tags for the current user.
